name: Zarrin
summary: Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin teaches the ways of Kaldorei cooking. He tends an open hearth on Teldrassil, where young night elves and visitors learn to prepare meals from the tree's native flora and fauna.

sections.title: Hearthkeeper of Dolanaar
sections.body: Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin tends an open cooking fire and teaches Kaldorei culinary arts. Teldrassil's native plants and animals provide food for those who live here. Zarrin shows visitors how to forage and prepare meals at home.

faq.answer: Find Zarrin behind the inn in Dolanaar, at a cooking fire in the open yard across from the road.
Zarrin teaches the basics of cooking and traditional night elf recipes to novices.
Zarrin asks travelers to help prepare traditional dishes through Recipe of the Kaldorei, teaching newcomers local cooking practices.

angles.text: As you begin your journey in Teldrassil, Zarrin can teach you to prepare nourishing meals from wild beast meat and foraged goods.
Zarrin keeps everyday Kaldorei foodways alive, passing traditional tastes and methods on beneath the World Tree's canopy.
